summary: Missoula County, MT 7x7-ft frame cab on a cliff above Boulder Lake in Lolo NF; built 1920 per one source; burned in a 2003 wildfire; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 7'x7' frame cab on a cliff overlooking Boulder Lake
facts.status_note: Burned in the 2003 wildfire season; no source describes what, if anything, remains

events.note: Built in 1920 as a 7x7 ft frame cab; single source
Lost to a wildfire in 2003; the FFLA chapter report names it among two lookouts lost to fires

evidence.supports: 7x7 ft frame cab, built in 1920, cliff over Boulder Lake, abandoned
evidence.quote: this 7x7' frame cab, built in 1920, had been abandoned

evidence.supports: abandoned for many years before the 2003 fire
evidence.quote: had been abandoned for many years. It burned in a 2003 forest fire.

evidence.supports: 2003 wildfire consumed what remained of the structures
evidence.quote: 2003: The structures remains were consumed in a wildfire.

evidence.supports: 2003 chapter report: two lookouts lost to fires, Boulder Lake among them
evidence.quote: lookouts were lost to fires, Silver King and Boulder Lake, both in Montana.

notes_for_editor: The 1920 build year rests on one source (Fire Lookout). The 2003 loss is supported by three sources. Two WebSearch queries returned only unrelated 2022 fire coverage. No source describes the site today or access.
